objective: 得到实用性高的修图模型；根据真实编辑结果持续改进数据和微调方法，小规模SFT只是首轮验证，不作为最终目标替代。

开发集功能与图像质量选模
网页端同路径实际试用

plan_adjustments.change: 新增sepia全局棕褐色工具；初始八工具扩展为九工具
plan_adjustments.reason: case-12原数据标签重放也呈黄绿色，未完成棕色调；单靠色温不足以可靠表达目标
plan_adjustments.comparison_policy: 底座、旧模型、新模型使用相同新工具和提示；保留旧流程对照，单独报告工具贡献

plan_adjustments.change: 明确新高光/阴影操作使用亮度掩码和有界调整
plan_adjustments.reason: 原流程全局提亮易损坏亮部；新版本逐工具验证，避免把不同颜色通道分别当成明暗区
plan_adjustments.comparison_policy: 所有新比较使用同一编辑器版本，历史结果不覆盖

plan_adjustments.reason: Direct Codex viewing rejected gray haze in the draft masked additive shadow lift; bounded gamma retains black and white endpoints.

plan_adjustments.change: High-tone-only darkening labels and editor v1.2
plan_adjustments.reason: Codex rejected several global darkening targets because already-dark faces also became harder to see. Negative highlights now lower bright values while sparing dark regions; stronger bounded shadow candidates address insufficient recovery.

disclosures: 训练任务将逐条标记原始请求、改写和可控合成来源，不能将合成请求称为原始自然请求
旧留出图有历史评测接触，不称为全新未见独立测试
AI辅助评审不能替代用户实际试用结论
候选图为最高1024边长的视觉核验预览；工具参数用于同版本全分辨率渲染
GIER source images include photographs, scans and at least one illustration; do not describe the entire controlled training set as real photographs.

review_policy.reason: Known factual contradictions in frozen 7B image judgments. Do not replace pixel-L1 with another unreliable automatic score.
review_policy.label_gate: Every admitted target must be actually viewed by Codex, fully instruction-complete, acceptable in image quality, and tied to exact input/output and contact-sheet hashes. Partial, failed or uncertain direct observations are not admitted.
review_policy.disagreement_policy: Preserve prior 7B disagreement and uncertain observations. Do not claim two-reviewer agreement or human certification. Uncertainty in the designated primary visual review remains excluded.
